mapper.select: SELECT p.part_id AS "id",p.part_nm AS "name",p.hq_yn AS "hqYn", (SELECT to_char(to_date(min(s.aply_bgn_ym),'YYYYMM'),'YYYY-MM') FROM tb_bs_part_std s WHERE s.part_id=p.part_id) AS "firstEffectiveMonth" FROM tb_bs_part p WHERE p.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY p.part_nm,p.part_id
SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd=#{key} AND aply_bgn_ym <=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT max(close_ym) FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE'
SELECT user_id FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user u JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND r.role_id='SALES_LDR' AND r.use_yn='Y')

SELECT part_id AS "partId",aply_bgn_ym AS "month",aply_end_ym AS "endMonth",part_ldr_user_id AS "leaderUserId", prft_dstrb_rt AS "profitRate",sales_exps_amt AS "salesExpenseAmount",reg_user_id AS "regUserId", reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_bs_part_std WHERE part_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.setl_ym FROM tb_co_part_setl s WHERE s.part_id=#{id} AND s.setl_ym >=#{month} AND s.setl_stat_cd IN ('CNFM','AUTO') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_cl_close c WHERE c.close_ym=s.setl_ym AND c.close_stat_cd='CLOSE') ORDER BY s.setl_ym
SELECT user_nm FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE part_id=#{id}

SELECT count(*) FROM tb_pj_proj p WHERE p.proj_stat_cd IN ('ING','PRE') AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_proj_part pp WHERE pp.proj_id=p.proj_id AND pp.part_id=#{id} AND pp.aply_bgn_ym=( SELECT max(x.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_pj_proj_part x WHERE x.proj_id=p.proj_id AND x.aply_bgn_ym <=#{month}))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bs_part_std SET aply_end_ym=#{endMonth,jdbcType=CHAR},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE part_id=#{partId} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{month}
